selection_rule: latest 20 percent by score date within each CT04 fitting set; date ties kept together; remove optimization components touching selection
selection_metric: earliest strict best selection RMSE among trained epochs; inner assessment never used
loss: raw-score MSE; equal CVE weight; vectorized mini-batches
shuffle: seed*1000003 + fold*1009 + epoch; identical between arms
ridge_selection: clipped selection RMSE, smallest alpha wins ties; optimization-only scaler and coefficients; no refit
primary_contrast: DM minus D pooled out-of-fold RMSE, arithmetic mean of per-seed metrics
interpretation: Retrospective Day-60 score estimation on previously used training records. Not independent confirmation or historically verified forecasting.
